the decision #4 completion check therefore awards against TotalCompleted(), not NetRecorded: a new award of EGP 250 is checkable; NetRecorded is only the in-flight risk ceiling while the transfer is open

scenarios.title: Seven-business-day processing clock crosses Coptic Easter and Sham El-Nessim (decisions #2, #36)
expectedObservableOutcomes: the Approved instant 2026-04-09 (Thursday) starts the seven-business-day processing clock; Friday 2026-04-10 and Saturday 2026-04-11 are the Cairo weekend

Sunday 2026-04-12 is Coptic Easter (computed via the Julian computus, not a fixed Gregorian date) and Monday 2026-04-13 is Sham El-Nessim — both are excluded per decision #36 even though Sunday is normally a business day

business day 7 lands on Wednesday 2026-04-22; the deadline instant is end-of-day 2026-04-22 in Africa/Cairo LOCAL time (the UTC mapping must be resolved through the host's tzdata — Egypt enters DST during this window, so a pinned UTC instant would be wrong on a mis-tzdata host)
without the #36 calendar the naive Sun–Thu count would land on Monday 2026-04-20 — the two excluded holidays shift the deadline by exactly two business days
